## T04-DIV-01 — The Q5 put to Bariah is not the Q5 in the frozen content model

Severity `MATERIAL_UNRESOLVED_DIVERGENCE`.

**Stems**

| Where | Stem |
|---|---|
| put to the authority in WhatsApp | Pilih SEMUA pernyataan yang tepat tentang kawalan semasa aktiviti semburan racun. |
| frozen in the content model | Pilih SEMUA kawalan yang mesti dipatuhi oleh kontraktor semasa aktiviti semburan racun. |

The frozen stem's source is AUTH-EV-01 §E — Bariah's own written replacement stem — Bariah's own written replacement. Firdaus's WhatsApp wording is different.

**Options**

| # | Put to the authority | Frozen in the model | Same? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Pengendali semburan mesti berlesen atau telah menerima latihan | Pengendali semburan mesti berlesen atau telah menerima latihan | yes |
| 2 | Pekerja mesti memakai PPE yang lengkap dan bersesuaian | Pekerja mesti memakai PPE yang lengkap dan bersesuaian | yes |

| 5 | Notifikasi kepada penduduk dibuat hanya selepas semburan selesai | Semburan dijadualkan pada waktu petang selepas waktu kerja tapak tamat | **NO** |
| 6 | SDS hanya perlu disimpan di pejabat projek dan tidak perlu berada di tapak | Semua racun dibeli daripada satu pembekal tunggal yang dilantik projek | **NO** |

**What this means.** Positions 1 to 4 are identical in both versions and are not in question. Bariah's 'Q5 multiple response - yes, ok' was written against Firdaus's set, not against the frozen set.

**Resolution.** Set B, verbatim. Neither the Stage 4.2F-B0.9 CAIR draft nor the earlier WhatsApp pair is in force; the selected pair supersedes both.
